author: A.J. Evans
title: Asphalt dump truck rolls on US-131 in Grand Rapids - NewsBreak
text:
By A.J. Evans ,
6 hours ago
GRAND RAPIDS, Mich. (WOOD) — Crews cleared a pile of asphalt off of US-131 in Grand Rapids after a dump truck overturned Wednesday, police say.
According to Michigan State Police, the crash happened at around 4:52 p.m. in the southbound lanes near Burton Street.
Inside woodtv.com: Live traffic conditions State police said their preliminary investigation showed a car was merging onto 131 and cut off the dump truck, causing it to roll. Statements from witnesses matched the investigation’s findings so far, police said.
The driver of the dump truck, a 22-year-old Grand Rapids man, suffered a broken arm and burns to his back. He was taken to a local hospital and is in stable condition, according to police.
A dump truck rolled over on southbound US-131 near Burton Street in Grand Rapids, spilling asphalt. (Aug. 12, 2026) A dump truck rolled over on southbound US-131 near Burton Street in Grand Rapids, spilling asphalt. (Aug. 12, 2026) Asphalt spilled onto the highway and covered multiple lanes, police said. Southbound US-131 was closed at Burton as crews worked to clear the roadway. It reopened before 6 p.m.
